policy: Original local evidence is retained. Published raw archive members redact only local paths/PATH; selected narrative reports clarify the public artifact layout. Top-level JSON/Markdown may receive repository whitespace formatting, recorded separately. Final executed harness and PNG bytes are unchanged. Independent review repro scripts are path-redacted and require remapping. No results are elided or relabeled.
